Maria (AE): Quick handoff for Cascadia Analytics — closed yesterday, $120k ARR. They want a private VPC deployment in eu-west-1, SAML SSO, and KMS/HSM. Target go-live ~5 weeks. Looping CS + support + product for tokenization concerns.

Jordan (CSM): I will own CSM. Timeline is tight; we'll need fast decisions on infra and SSO. I'll draft a success plan and weekly check-ins.

Devon (Onboarding): I'll run the kickoff + enablement track. Need customer technical lead, desired latency SLOs for long-doc ingestion, and sample docs. Planning a 90-min workshop.

Maria (AE): Customer ENG lead = Samir (email on contract). I opened infra ticket INF-4926 for private deploy + KMS + SSO. Copying short ticket details below.

Maria (AE): INF-4926 summary:
``
Customer: Cascadia Analytics
Scope: Private VPC deployment (eu-west-1), KMS/HSM integration, SAML SSO
Constraints: EU data residency, SOC2/DPA required
Requested ETA: 5 weeks
``

Lee (Support Eng): I can own infra triage and runtime escalation. Adding myself to INF-4926. Questions: which model variant do they expect to run, and do they require sub-500ms p95? Also, will they provide sample long-docs for tokenization validation?

Alex (PM): I'll track tokenization/embedding acceptance criteria and capture any regressions. Put me on the onboarding notes; I'll prepare a short eval plan to run on the samples.

Jordan (CSM): Owners & immediate next steps (please ack):
- Devon: schedule kickoff + deliver enablement checklist (owner: Devon; due: 24h after kickoff)
- Lee: join INF-4926, run perf baseline, post results (owner: Lee; due: 3 business days after kickoff)
- Alex: publish tokenization acceptance criteria + quick eval plan (owner: Alex; due: 2 business days after kickoff)
- Maria: intro Samir and attach contract artifacts (done)
- Samir/Cascadia: provide sample docs + technical attendee (due: by kickoff)

Devon (Onboarding): I'll send invites for Wed 10:00 CET and a pre-kickoff questionnaire (roles, access, success metrics, test data).

Samir (Cascadia Eng): Wed 10:00 CET works for us. We'll upload 3 sample long-docs and have our platform engineer on the call.

Lee (Support Eng): I'll run a light perf probe during the kickoff and capture traces. Checklist I'll use:
``
- model variant + params
- sample docs (3)
- desired latency SLOs (p50/p95)
- quantization expectation (yes/no)
- network/VPC peering details
- KMS/HSM access plan
```

Maria (AE): Legal requested SOC2 + signed DPA for EU residency; finance is good. Sales uploaded SOC2 to contract folder.

Jordan (CSM): Risk register notes:
- Timeline risk: medium (infra + HSM procurement may add weeks)
- Renewal risk: low at present but tied to go-live quality
- SSO/KMS vendor approvals are potential blockers

Alex (PM): I'll prepare an automated eval harness to run tokenization checks against the sample docs and flag edge cases.

Devon (Onboarding): ack

Lee (Support Eng): ack

Alex (PM): ack

Maria (AE): ack

Samir (Cascadia Eng): ack

ops-bot: INF-4926 updated: Lee (Support Eng) added, status -> in_progress

Jordan (CSM): I'll create the Gainsight handoff record and schedule a 1-week post-kickoff sync. If blockers pop before then, tag @support and @eng-runtime. I'll post a handoff summary to the CS tracker after this thread. Thanks everyone.
